By disposition 97 are domain logic that belongs in core Rust, 32 orchestration, 34 glue, 3 dead, 14 generated and 43 platform adaptors. A user of the tool needs Bash to run any of it, and Perl reaches the tree through shasum on macOS.

Audit z 2026-09-15 klasifikoval 223 jednotek: scripts/ci je 44 souborů a 6 017 řádků, ostatní skripty a bin 82 souborů a 14 860 řádků, lib 45 souborů a 19 513 řádků a 216 shellových testovacích případů 30 872 řádků. Podle dispozice je 97 doménová logika, která patří do jádra v Rustu, 32 orchestrace, 34 lepidlo, 3 mrtvé, 14 generované a 43 platformní adaptéry. en: <t1>Knowledge pointers.</t1> A bounded slice of the knowledge graph, not the graph: one line per pointer — the relation that selected it, the kind, the id, the source path and the title. Selection follows only edges a file states, in this order, each tier in byte order of the id: the issue the task was started for, the issues it <t2/>, its milestone, the claims that milestone declares, and every node whose source is a path the task or the issue names in its <t3/>. Nothing is searched and nothing is scored — a document whose words match the issue's but that nothing references is not selected. The list stops at the profile's <t4/> (the policy's <t5/> when unset, and never above it), and a last line counts the rest with <t6/>, which prints them. The section is absent, and named under <t7/> with the reason, when the profile does not set <t8/>, and when the task names no issue under a policy whose <t9/> is not <t10/>; with no task, or with binding off and no issue, it is simply absent. Only the kinds and paths the selection can reach are compiled, so it costs about two seconds on a plan of four hundred issues rather than the eight a whole compile takes; it is a few lines of a 300-line budget. When the issue the task names is not a node — its record left the version-control index, or is gone — the section prints a <t11/> line saying which and why, and still lists what the graph does hold. Under a tight budget it is dropped with the derived listings, after files and before the context documents, and so long before git, the task, the profile and the open questions, which are never dropped; the drop names the command that prints the pointers.

Seznam se zastaví na <t4/> profilu (<t5/> politiky, když není nastaveno, a nikdy nad ním) a poslední řádek spočítá zbytek pomocí <t6/>, který je vytiskne.
